verdict.rationale: GitHub documents that Copilot review feedback includes suggested changes you can apply with a couple of clicks, and that GitHub Mobile lets you edit files in pull requests. It also documents a cloud-based development environment (Codespaces). None of the evidence explicitly describes manually editing files and committing them in the web browser in response to human review comments. Missing for 10: explicit docs on in-browser file editing and committing on GitHub.com, applying human reviewer suggestions in the browser, and confirmation that Codespaces runs in the browser.

support.subject: As a developer, I can respond to review feedback by editing and committing code directly in the browser

citations.quote: Where possible, Copilot's feedback includes suggested changes which you can apply with a couple of clicks.
Launch a full, cloud-based development environment in seconds.
